query: SELECT id AS "id!: String" FROM cached_fleet_records WHERE kind = 'workspace' AND id > ?2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(json_extract(payload, '$.record.repositories')) attached WHERE json_extract(attached.value, '$.kind') = json_extract(?1, '$.kind') AND ((json_extract(?1, '$.kind') = 'origin' AND json_extract(attached.value, '$.normalizedOrigin') = json_extract(?1, '$.normalizedOrigin')) OR (json_extract(?1, '$.kind') = 'local' AND json_extract(attached.value, '$.serviceId') = json_extract(?1, '$.serviceId') AND json_extract(attached.value, '$.commonDirectory') = json_extract(?1, '$.commonDirectory')))) ORDER BY id LIMIT ?3
